items.title: Experience, Persona-style
items.body: A level every ~5 fights against enemies of your level (the first ones faster); enemies give XP by their own level; story awards are a share of your level.

items.title: Personas grow on their own
items.body: A Wild Card's Persona earns the fight's XP and can pass your level; the others only with Growth. Teammates move together with their Persona.

items.title: Change Persona in battle
items.body: A Wild Card can switch Persona on their turn — free, once a turn.

items.title: Persona look
items.body: Persona 4 style for the stats panel, fights, Shuffle Time, dungeons and the chat, in yellow, blue, red or your own colours.
